decisions.title: Record the applied Supabase EXECUTE restriction
decisions.scope: P0 security-control evidence only; no product schema or application behavior
decisions.decision: Record migration 20260828192126_p0_restrict_rls_auto_enable_execution as an already-applied security control while preserving the function body, SECURITY DEFINER property, ensure_rls event trigger, schema design, and all other privileges.
decisions.rationale: The supplied post-remediation evidence shows direct EXECUTE is false for anonymous and authenticated roles, true for postgres and service_role, ensure_rls remains enabled for ddl_command_end, and both Supabase advisors returned no findings.

decisions.title: Bound physical Migration 1 to application identity
decisions.decision: Implement physical Migration 1 with the public users application-identity relation, server-generated UUID and timestamps, a restricted timestamp trigger function, explicit Data API grants, and immediate RLS. Add no profile, capability, jurisdiction, provider, or later-phase relation and no additional extension without a concrete locked dependency.
decisions.rationale: The locked physical sequence places auth/application identity in Migration 1. The users relation is the smallest locked application identity, while client, attorney, staff, capability, and session relations have explicit later migration owners. PostgreSQL 17 already provides gen_random_uuid and both active projects already contain the required Supabase platform extensions, so adding another extension would be speculative.
decisions.impact: Records the protected-review-approved P1 Migration 1 application to Rosuno Staging only; it is not a production release or deployment and does not authorize later P1 work.

decisions.title: Propose physical Migration 2 authorization foundation
decisions.scope: P1/1B authorization foundation only; rollback-only Staging validation
decisions.decision: Create one ordered Migration 2 artifact containing only client, attorney, and staff profiles, a stable capability-definition catalog, capability grants, and application-session metadata. Reuse public.users and public.set_updated_at() unchanged; leave jurisdiction_id nullable without a foreign key until locked Migration 3.
decisions.rationale: The locked physical sequence places profile identity, capability definitions and grants, and application session metadata after the applied application-identity foundation. This proposal deliberately excludes jurisdictions, authorization helpers, authentication workflows, secrets, seeds, production application, and later P1 relations.
decisions.impact: Adds only a proposed, unreviewed, rollback-only Migration 2 artifact and sanitized Staging validation evidence; it does not authorize persistent application, production release, or later P1 work.

decisions.title: Accept physical Migration 3 regulatory control foundation
decisions.scope: P1/1C jurisdiction, policy, and launch-gate foundation only; accepted Rosuno Staging application
decisions.decision: Accept the protected-review-approved Migration 3 artifact and its one-time persistent Rosuno Staging application. The accepted boundary contains only jurisdiction-neutral jurisdictions and service areas, regulatory modes and their effective-dated jurisdiction relationships, versioned policy configuration with authority provenance, launch gates, evaluations, explicit launch authorizations, and the deferred restrictive capability-grant jurisdiction foreign key.
decisions.rationale: Locked Physical Migration 3 owns this regulatory control plane. Final acceptance confirmed exact migration history and catalog structure, default-deny client security, zero seed data, intact prior controls, and no unapproved advisor finding. Counsel-gated values remain unseeded, verified authority provenance remains mandatory before policy approval, and LIVE jurisdiction status still requires an independent active launch authorization.
decisions.impact: Records the accepted non-production application of Migration 3 to Rosuno Staging only; it is not a production release, does not authorize counsel-gated configuration, and does not authorize P1-004 or later work.
